10 / For every Dogecoin success story, there’s a graveyard of projects that crashed to zero—fast. 

Memecoins are a high-risk, high-reward game. Stay level-headed, keep your research tight, and don’t let FOMO override common sense. 

The line between meme hero and meme casualty

1 / Picture Dogecoin or Shiba Inu—tokens born from viral memes yet capable of massive market swings. 

Don’t be deceived by the ‘fun factor.’
